statistical_review.simpson: Domains and five blocks separated; pooled users also reported, no cross-domain pooled winner.
statistical_review.ecological: Mean gains do not imply all users benefit.
statistical_review.berkson: Eligibility excludes fitting holdouts; not raw interaction population.
statistical_review.collider: No outcome-based cohort or block selection.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Larger development sample still not independent final confirmation.
statistical_review.survivorship: All11 arms required for every user; failed jobs cannot produce complete success.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: All 512 comparisons saved; intervals descriptive, unadjusted.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Fixed alpha/beta predeclared; original checkpoints and score scale unchanged.
statistical_review.causation: Expert comparisons conditional on frozen equal fusion and generation protocol.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Targets used only for metrics, never weights, scores or encoding.
